segments.ja172:1.1: Ko nu saddena mahatā, abhinādeti daddaraṃ;
segments.ja172:1.3: Taṃ sīhā nappaṭinadanti [kiṃ sīhā nappaṭinadanti (sī. pī.), na sīhā paṭinadanti (ka.)], ko nāmeso migādhibhū.

lines: Tattha abhinādeti daddaranti daddaraṃ rajatapabbataṃ ekanādaṃ karoti.
Ayañhettha attho – migādhibhū migajeṭṭhaka sīharāja pucchāmi taṃ “ko nāmeso”ti.
